goal.vi: Xử lý khi lỡ chuyến, chuyến bay bị hủy, mất hành lý hoặc đổi cổng.
goal.en: Deal with a missed or canceled flight, a lost bag or a gate change.

lines: Hi. My flight was canceled. Can you rebook me?
I'm sorry about that. The next flight is tomorrow morning.
Will the airline cover a hotel for tonight?
Thank you. Also, my bag didn't arrive on my first flight. Where do I report it?
At the baggage office, next to belt 6.
And excuse me, has the gate changed for the morning flight?

phrases.say: I missed my connecting flight. What are my options?
phrases.not: My plane go already. What I do?

mean.vi: Hỏi có cách giải quyết nào khi lỡ chuyến
mean.en: Ask what you can do after missing a flight

why.vi: "What are my options?" giúp nhân viên đưa ra giải pháp.
why.en: "What are my options?" helps the agent offer solutions.

phrases.say: My flight was canceled. Can you rebook me?
phrases.not: They cancel my flight, give me other.

mean.vi: Xin đặt lại chuyến bay khác
mean.en: Ask for a seat on another flight

why.vi: "Rebook" là từ nhân viên hàng không thường dùng.
why.en: "Rebook" is the exact word airline staff use.

phrases.say: My bag didn't arrive. Where do I report it?

why.vi: "Luggage" không có số nhiều: nói "bags" hoặc "my luggage".
why.en: "Luggage" has no plural: say "bags" or "my luggage".

phrases.say: How much is it if my bag is overweight?
phrases.not: My bag is too much heavy.

mean.vi: Hỏi phí khi hành lý quá cân
mean.en: Ask the cost for a heavy bag

why.vi: Nói "too heavy" hoặc "overweight", không nói "too much heavy".
why.en: Say "too heavy" or "overweight", not "too much heavy".

phrases.say: Will the airline cover a hotel for tonight?

mean.vi: Hỏi hãng có lo khách sạn không
mean.en: Ask if the airline will pay for a hotel

why.vi: Hỏi hãng sẽ "cover" những gì khi chuyến bay trễ lâu.
why.en: Ask what the airline will "cover" after a long delay.

phrases.say: Excuse me, has the gate changed?

mean.vi: Hỏi cổng ra máy bay có đổi không
mean.en: Ask if your gate is different now

why.vi: Dùng "has… changed" cho thay đổi vừa xảy ra.
why.en: Use "has… changed" for a change that just happened.

phrases.say: My flight leaves in 30 minutes. Could I go ahead of you?
phrases.not: I am late, let me first!

mean.vi: Xin đi trước khi bạn sắp trễ chuyến
mean.en: Ask to go first in a line

why.vi: Nói lý do trước rồi mới nhờ; mọi người sẽ sẵn lòng giúp.
why.en: Give the reason, then ask; people are happy to help.

ai.name: Tom
ai.role: an airline agent at the help desk
ai.goal: rebook the learner and solve their problems

roleplay.you: Your flight was canceled and your bag is missing. Ask for a new flight, ask about a hotel and ask where to report your bag.

turns.a: Next, please. How can I help?
turns.h: Hi. My flight was canceled. Can you rebook me?
br: Let me look… The next flight is tomorrow at 8 a.m.

turns.h: Okay. Will the airline cover a hotel for tonight?
Yes. My bag didn't arrive. Where do I report it?
br: At the baggage office, next to belt 6.

turns.a: Do you have your bag tag?
turns.h: Yes, here it is. Has the gate changed for tomorrow's flight?
br: Good question. It's gate B12 now.

roleplay.end: You're all set. Sorry for the trouble, and have a good night!
